summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the closed contract for deterministic inference case activation. It validates facility priors, governed library triggers and quality records; emits activation-only InferenceCase, ActivationRecord and TriggerLogEntry outputs; preserves lineage, provenance and version metadata; and does not perform Decision Core analysis.

findings: Inputs match the functional contract: facility_prior from motor_012, governed library_objects from motor_011 and quality_records from motor_007 are required before activation.
Outputs match the contract: activated cases, activation records and trigger logs are emitted with deterministic reason codes and stable references.
The implementation rejects missing prior identity, invalid library objects, missing trigger fields, scope mismatch and blocked quality through structured error or rejected activation records.
Duplicate matching triggers for the same facility, source prior, prior version, case type and rule version are collapsed into one InferenceCase with supporting_trigger_refs.

InferenceCase, ActivationRecord and TriggerLogEntry models carry required identifiers, source references, produced_by_motor, produced_at, lineage_id, lineage_refs, provenance_refs, version_id and version_hash fields.
The engine computes stable identifiers and hashes from accepted inputs and activation rule version rather than mutable labels, timestamps alone or list position.
Quality record references and conditional quality notes are propagated into activated cases without recalculating upstream quality.

test_results.coverage_assessment: The documented test specification covers happy path, sparse case, malformed input and edge cases. One executable smoke test was run against the implementation using the documented happy-path fixture and produced one activated case, one activation record and one trigger log with reason_code TRIGGER_MATCHED.
test_results.notes: No formal standalone test runner exists inside the allowed conformance_review write scope. The executable check imported the implementation with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 to avoid writing cache files and verified the core activation path.
